description.value: Lodged and sealed in an indestructable stone collumn, removing the Z-Sword is a herculean task of almost divine proportions. To succeed in removing the sword you must succeed in 3 DC 20 Athletics Checks or take 1 Rank of Exhaustion on a failure as you end up slipping off the blade with skinned hands. You may add half of your current Power Bonus to this Athletics Checks.
